statements.select:
SELECT A.OPPT_CD , A.OPPT_TYPE , dbo.FN_GET_CODE_NM(#language#, 'OPPT_TYPE', A.OPPT_TYPE) AS OPPT_TYPE_NM , A.ITEM_CD , DBO.FN_GET_ITEM_NM(A.ITEM_CD) AS ITEM_NM , (SELECT ITEM_CD2 FROM T_ITEM WHERE ITEM_CD = A.ITEM_CD) AS ITEM_CD2 , A.BIZ_TYPE , dbo.FN_GET_CODE_NM(#language#, 'BIZ_TYPE', A.BIZ_TYPE) AS BIZ_TYPE_NM , (SELECT dbo.FN_GET_CODE_NM(#language#, 'ITEM_TYPE', ITEM_TYPE) FROM T_ITEM WHERE ITEM_CD = A.ITEM_CD) AS ITEM_TYPE_NM , A.CUST_CD , DBO.FN_GET_CUST_NM(A.CUST_CD) AS CUST_NM , (SELECT BAD_AR_YN FROM T_CUSTOMER WHERE CUST_CD = A.CUST_CD) AS BAD_AR_YN , A.USER_CD , DBO.FN_GET_USER_NM(A.USER_CD) AS USER_NM , A.DEPT_CD , DBO.FN_GET_DEPT_NM(A.DEPT_CD) AS DEPT_NM , A.EUSER_CD , DBO.FN_GET_CUST_NM(A.EUSER_CD) AS EUSER_NM , A.DSTR_TYPE , dbo.FN_GET_CODE_NM(#language#, 'DSTR_TYPE', A.DSTR_TYPE) AS DSTR_TYPE_NM , A.OPPT_STATUS , dbo.FN_GET_CODE_NM(#language#, 'OPPT_STATUS', A.OPPT_STATUS) AS OPPT_STATUS_NM , A.WSO_PSBLT , dbo.FN_GET_CODE_NM(#language#, 'WSO_PSBLT', A.WSO_PSBLT) AS WSO_PSBLT_NM , (SELECT VALUE_2 FROM T_CODE WHERE UP_CODE_ID = 'WSO_PSBLT' AND CODE_ID = A.WSO_PSBLT) AS WSO_PSBLT_VALUE , A.BASE_CRNY , A.EXCH_RATE , (SELECT SUM(OPPT_QTY) FROM T_OPPT_ITEM WHERE OPPT_CD = A.OPPT_CD) AS OPPT_QTY , CASE WHEN (SELECT SUM(OPPT_QTY) FROM T_OPPT_ITEM WHERE OPPT_CD = A.OPPT_CD) != 0 THEN (SELECT SUM(AMOUNT) FROM T_OPPT_ITEM WHERE OPPT_CD = A.OPPT_CD)/(SELECT SUM(OPPT_QTY) FROM T_OPPT_ITEM WHERE OPPT_CD = A.OPPT_CD) ELSE 0 END AS OPPT_UNIT_PRC , (SELECT SUM(AMOUNT) FROM T_OPPT_ITEM WHERE OPPT_CD = A.OPPT_CD) AS AMOUNT , (SELECT SUM(KRW_AMOUNT) FROM T_OPPT_ITEM WHERE OPPT_CD = A.OPPT_CD) AS KRW_AMOUNT , A.PJT_CD , DBO.FN_GET_PJT_NM(A.PJT_CD) AS PJT_NM , A.WSO_PDATE , A.OPPT_SUMRY , A.RFC_CD FROM T_OPPORTUNITY A LEFT OUTER JOIN T_DEPARTMENT AS D ON A.COMPANY_CD = D.COMPANY_CD AND A.DEPT_CD = D.DEPT_CD WHERE A.COMPANY_CD = #company_cd# AND A.DROP_YN = 'N' AND A.USE_YN = 'Y'
AND A.DEPT_CD = #deptGroup#
AND D.UP_DEPT_CD = #bizGroup# AND A.DEPT_CD IS NOT NULL
AND A.USER_CD = #user_cd#
AND A.DSTR_TYPE = #dstr_type#
AND A.WSO_PDATE BETWEEN REPLACE(#sdate#, '-', '') AND REPLACE(#edate#, '-', '')
AND (A.CUST_CD LIKE '%'+ #cust_cd# +'%' )
AND A.BIZ_TYPE = #biz_type#
AND A.OPPT_TYPE = #oppt_type#
AND A.OPPT_STATUS = #oppt_status#
AND A.EUSER_CD = #euser_cd#
AND A.ITEM_CD IN (SELECT ITEM_CD FROM T_ITEM WHERE ITEM_TYPE = #item_type#)
AND A.ITEM_CD IN (SELECT ITEM_CD FROM T_ITEM WHERE ITEM_NM = #item_nm#)
AND A.RFC_CD = #rfc_cd#
AND A.WSO_PSBLT = #wso_psblt#
AND A.CUST_CD IN (SELECT CUST_CD FROM T_CUSTOMER WHERE BCUST_CD LIKE '%'+ #bcust_cd# +'%' )
AND A.PJT_CD = #pjt_cd#

SELECT A.OPPT_CD , A.OPPT_TYPE , dbo.FN_GET_CODE_NM(#language#, 'OPPT_TYPE', A.OPPT_TYPE) AS OPPT_TYPE_NM , A.ITEM_CD , DBO.FN_GET_ITEM_NM(A.ITEM_CD) AS ITEM_NM , (SELECT ITEM_CD2 FROM T_ITEM WHERE ITEM_CD = A.ITEM_CD) AS ITEM_CD2 , A.BIZ_TYPE , dbo.FN_GET_CODE_NM(#language#, 'BIZ_TYPE', A.BIZ_TYPE) AS BIZ_TYPE_NM , (SELECT dbo.FN_GET_CODE_NM(#language#, 'ITEM_TYPE', ITEM_TYPE) FROM T_ITEM WHERE ITEM_CD = A.ITEM_CD) AS ITEM_TYPE_NM , A.CUST_CD , DBO.FN_GET_CUST_NM(A.CUST_CD) AS CUST_NM , (SELECT BAD_AR_YN FROM T_CUSTOMER WHERE CUST_CD = A.CUST_CD) AS BAD_AR_YN , A.USER_CD , DBO.FN_GET_USER_NM(A.USER_CD) AS USER_NM , A.DEPT_CD , DBO.FN_GET_DEPT_NM(A.DEPT_CD) AS DEPT_NM , A.EUSER_CD , DBO.FN_GET_CUST_NM(A.EUSER_CD) AS EUSER_NM , A.DSTR_TYPE , dbo.FN_GET_CODE_NM(#language#, 'DSTR_TYPE', A.DSTR_TYPE) AS DSTR_TYPE_NM , A.OPPT_STATUS , dbo.FN_GET_CODE_NM(#language#, 'OPPT_STATUS', A.OPPT_STATUS) AS OPPT_STATUS_NM , A.WSO_PSBLT , dbo.FN_GET_CODE_NM(#language#, 'WSO_PSBLT', A.WSO_PSBLT) AS WSO_PSBLT_NM , (SELECT VALUE_2 FROM T_CODE WHERE UP_CODE_ID = 'WSO_PSBLT' AND CODE_ID = A.WSO_PSBLT) AS WSO_PSBLT_VALUE , A.BASE_CRNY , A.EXCH_RATE , (SELECT SUM(OPPT_QTY) FROM T_OPPT_ITEM WHERE OPPT_CD = A.OPPT_CD) AS OPPT_QTY , CASE WHEN (SELECT SUM(OPPT_QTY) FROM T_OPPT_ITEM WHERE OPPT_CD = A.OPPT_CD) != 0 THEN (SELECT SUM(AMOUNT) FROM T_OPPT_ITEM WHERE OPPT_CD = A.OPPT_CD)/(SELECT SUM(OPPT_QTY) FROM T_OPPT_ITEM WHERE OPPT_CD = A.OPPT_CD) ELSE 0 END AS OPPT_UNIT_PRC , (SELECT SUM(AMOUNT) FROM T_OPPT_ITEM WHERE OPPT_CD = A.OPPT_CD) AS AMOUNT , (SELECT SUM(KRW_AMOUNT) FROM T_OPPT_ITEM WHERE OPPT_CD = A.OPPT_CD) AS KRW_AMOUNT , A.PJT_CD , DBO.FN_GET_PJT_NM(A.PJT_CD) AS PJT_NM , A.WSO_PDATE , A.OPPT_SUMRY , A.RFC_CD , A.RFC_CHASU FROM T_OPPORTUNITY A WHERE A.COMPANY_CD = #company_cd# AND A.DROP_YN = 'N' AND A.USE_YN = 'Y'
AND A.OPPT_CD = #oppt_cd#

SELECT A.OPPT_CD , A.ITEM_CD , C.ITEM_CD2 , C.ITEM_NM , A.BASE_CRNY , A.EXCH_RATE , B.OPPT_QTY , B.OPPT_UNIT_PRC , B.AMOUNT , B.KRW_AMOUNT , B.SALES_DATE FROM T_OPPORTUNITY A, T_OPPT_ITEM B, T_ITEM C WHERE A.COMPANY_CD = B.COMPANY_CD AND A.COMPANY_CD = #company_cd# AND A.OPPT_CD = B.OPPT_CD AND A.ITEM_CD = B.ITEM_CD AND B.ITEM_CD = C.ITEM_CD AND A.OPPT_CD = #oppt_cd#

SELECT COMPANY_CD , SMP_CD , ITEM_CD , (SELECT ITEM_CD2 FROM T_ITEM WHERE ITEM_CD = A.ITEM_CD) AS ITEM_CD2 , DBO.FN_GET_ITEM_NM(A.ITEM_CD) AS ITEM_NM , PJT_CD , DBO.FN_GET_PJT_NM(A.PJT_CD) AS PJT_NM , CUST_CD , DBO.FN_GET_CUST_NM(A.CUST_CD) AS CUST_NM , EUSER_CD , DBO.FN_GET_CUST_NM(A.EUSER_CD) AS EUSER_NM , BIZ_TYPE , dbo.FN_GET_CODE_NM(#language#, 'BIZ_TYPE', A.BIZ_TYPE) AS BIZ_TYPE_NM , DSTR_TYPE , dbo.FN_GET_CODE_NM(#language#, 'DSTR_TYPE', A.DSTR_TYPE) AS DSTR_TYPE_NM , USER_CD , DBO.FN_GET_USER_NM(A.USER_CD) AS USER_NM , DEPT_CD , DBO.FN_GET_DEPT_NM(A.DEPT_CD) AS DEPT_NM , CUST_SMP_CD , MOLD_NO , RUSER_CD , MUSER_CD , MDEPT_CD , SMP_STATUS , PRDT_PSBLT , dbo.FN_GET_CODE_NM(#language#, 'PRDT_PSBLT', A.PRDT_PSBLT) AS PRDT_PSBLT_NM , DBO.FN_GET_DATE_FORMAT(SMP_RDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS SMP_RDATE , PRDT_RCDATE , CMPT_RDATE , PRDT_RDATE , PRDT_ADATE , PRDT_CDATE , SHIP_PDATE , PRDT_RUSER , PRDT_AUSER , PRDT_CUSER , SHIP_PUSER , SMP_SUMRY , BASE_CRNY , EXCH_RATE , USE_YN FROM T_SAMPLE A WHERE A.COMPANY_CD = #company_cd# AND A.SMP_CD = #smp_cd# AND A.ITEM_CD = #item_cd# AND A.SMP_CHASU = #smp_chasu#
SELECT OPPT_CD FROM T_OPPORTUNITY WHERE RFC_CD = #smp_cd# AND RFC_CHASU = #smp_chasu#
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_OPPORTUNITY WHERE RFC_CD = #rfc_cd#
statements.insert:
IF NOT EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM T_OPPORTUNITY WHERE COMPANY_CD = #company_cd# AND OPPT_CD = #oppt_cd# ) INSERT INTO T_OPPORTUNITY ( COMPANY_CD , OPPT_CD , ITEM_CD , PJT_CD , OPPT_TYPE , BIZ_TYPE , DSTR_TYPE , CUST_CD , EUSER_CD , EUSER_NM , USER_CD , DEPT_CD , OPPT_STATUS , WSO_PSBLT , WSO_PDATE , OPPT_SUMRY , BASE_CRNY , EXCH_RATE
, RFC_CD , RFC_CHASU
, DROP_YN , REG_DT , REG_USR ) VALUES ( #company_cd# , #oppt_cd# , #item_cd# , #pjt_cd# , #oppt_type# , #biz_type# , #dstr_type# , #cust_cd# , #euser_cd# , #euser_nm# , #user_cd# , #dept_cd# , #oppt_status# , #wso_psblt# , dbo.FN_GET_DATE_FORMAT(#wso_pdate#, 'YYYYMMDD') , #oppt_sumry# , #base_crny# , #exch_rate#
, #rfc_cd# , #rfc_chasu#
, 'N' , getdate() , #reg_usr# ) ELSE UPDATE T_OPPORTUNITY SET PJT_CD = #pjt_cd# , OPPT_TYPE = #oppt_type# , BIZ_TYPE = #biz_type# , DSTR_TYPE = #dstr_type# , CUST_CD = #cust_cd# , EUSER_CD = #euser_cd# , EUSER_NM = #euser_nm# , USER_CD = #user_cd# , DEPT_CD = #dept_cd# , OPPT_STATUS = #oppt_status# , WSO_PSBLT = #wso_psblt# , WSO_PDATE = dbo.FN_GET_DATE_FORMAT(#wso_pdate#, 'YYYYMMDD') , OPPT_SUMRY = #oppt_sumry# , BASE_CRNY = #base_crny# , EXCH_RATE = #exch_rate#
, RFC_CD = #rfc_cd# , RFC_CHASU = #rfc_chasu#
, MOD_DT = GETDATE() , MOD_USR = #mod_usr# WHERE COMPANY_CD = #company_cd# AND OPPT_CD = #oppt_cd#
statements.delete: DELETE T_OPPT_ITEM WHERE COMPANY_CD = #company_cd# AND OPPT_CD = #oppt_cd#
statements.insert: INSERT INTO T_OPPT_ITEM ( COMPANY_CD , OPPT_CD , ITEM_CD , SALES_DATE , OPPT_QTY , OPPT_UNIT_PRC , AMOUNT , KRW_AMOUNT , REG_DT , REG_USR ) VALUES ( #company_cd# , #oppt_cd# , #item_cd# , dbo.FN_GET_DATE_FORMAT(#sales_date#, 'YYYYMMDD') , #oppt_qty# , #oppt_unit_prc# , #amount# , #krw_amount# , getdate() , #reg_usr# )
INSERT INTO T_OPPT_DROP VALUES ( #company_cd# , #oppt_cd# , #user_cd# , dbo.FN_GET_DATE_FORMAT(#oppt_drdate#, 'YYYYMMDD') , #oppt_drtype# , #oppt_drdescript# , GETDATE() , #reg_usr# )
statements.update: UPDATE T_OPPORTUNITY SET DROP_YN = 'Y' , OPPT_STATUS = 'OPSTAT_900' WHERE COMPANY_CD = #company_cd# AND OPPT_CD = #oppt_cd#
